message: Property is high-risk for print/PDF (can force rasterization): backdrop-filter

"z-index: 5" on ".page:has(#c2-style) .section > p:first-of-type::after" makes the page box a stacking context, so a .gp-behind image is trapped inside it and paints ABOVE the page's text instead of under it. Core keeps .page/.spread at "position: relative; z-index: auto" for this reason. This is an early source-only check; the build-time engine.layer.trapped audit is authoritative for the live ancestor chain.

"backdrop-filter: blur(2pt)" on ".page:has(#c2-style) .section > p:first-of-type::after" makes the page box a stacking context, so a .gp-behind image is trapped inside it and paints ABOVE the page's text instead of under it.
